dates.title: WashU Admissions - Application Dates & Deadlines (Fall 2027 first-year)

test_policy.notes: Standardized testing is optional and requirements are described as flexible: SAT, ACT, national exam results, IB, A-Levels or AP/IB exams may be submitted.

requirements.supplemental_essays: 250-word response on what you want to study and why; Signature Scholar Programs need a 250-word short answer per program; optional 90-second video. Portfolio required for the College of Art and strongly encouraged for Architecture.
requirements.notes: One teacher evaluation and one counselor recommendation. WashU does not conduct evaluative interviews; third-party interview supplements such as InitialView are encouraged but optional and not submitting one is not a disadvantage. CSS Profile is part of the financial aid application (required for aid applicants). QuestBridge is listed as an application route but its dates are on QuestBridge's site. Early Action is a newly added round.

deadlines.notes: Newly added nonbinding Early Action round; decisions released by Dec 23; reply due May 1. Page labels these dates 'Fall 2027 first-year applicants' without writing the calendar year.
Early Decision I; reply due Jan 4.
Early Decision II; reply due Mar 1.
Decisions released by Apr 1; reply due May 1.

deadlines.notes: Stated as December 16, 2026 on the international page; the dates page lists Dec 16 scholarship priority for all rounds.

english_policy.waiver_notes: International students whose second language is English must submit TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo. Students with 3+ years in an English-medium program may be exempted if academically strong (mostly-online schools typically do not qualify); other cases reviewed individually (admissions@wustl.edu). From fall 2027, SAT/ACT scores no longer substitute. Last tests accepted: December 2026 (October for EA/ED I). Undocumented/DACA students are not required to submit.

english.notes: Exams before 2026-01-21; recommended minimum, not a cutoff.
Exams on or after 2026-01-21; recommended minimum, not a cutoff.
IELTS Academic; recommended minimum, not a cutoff.

aid.notes: Page states WashU meets 100 percent of demonstrated need for all admitted undergraduates; international applicants are eligible for aid only if they apply for it during the admission process. The page does not say whether admission is need-blind or need-aware for international applicants. School Scholarships (up to full tuition, four-year) need no separate application; Signature Scholar Programs need a December 16, 2026 submission for priority.

tier_notes.business: Olin Business School is a top-15 undergraduate business program.
tier_notes.biology_life_sci: Top-10 life sciences with WashU School of Medicine.
tier_notes.pre_med: Strong pre-med outcomes and research access through WashU Medicine.
